modes.definition_zh: 夫童心者，绝假纯真，最初一念之本心也。以不受外界教条污染的'本心'作为判断一切价值的终极标准，反对用儒家经典和外在规范遮蔽内心的真实体验。
modes.definition_en: 'Childlike mind' is absolute authenticity—the first unfiltered thought of one's original heart. Using this unmediated 'original mind' as the ultimate standard for judging all values.
process: 回归不受外界教条污染的'最初一念'
以童心的真实感受作为价值判断标准
拒绝用经典文本遮蔽内心的直接体验
在绝对真诚中建立独立判断能力
modes.key_quote_zh: 童心者，真心也；绝假纯真，最初一念之本心也
modes.key_quote_en: Childlike mind is the sincere heart; absolutely fake-free and purely true, it is the original heart of the first unfiltered thought.
representative_cases_zh: 《童心说》原文论述
批判道学家'闻见从耳目而入'丧失童心

modes.name_en: Material Praxis Method (Dressing and Eating as Human Ethics)
modes.definition_zh: 穿衣吃饭，即是人伦物理。道不在超越的形上世界，而存在于百姓的日常物质生活之中。将伦理道德从空谈心性拉回到现实生存需求。
modes.definition_en: 'Dressing and eating constitute human ethics and physical principles.' Dao does not exist in a transcendent metaphysical realm but within the daily material life of common people.
process: 确认物质生存是人类存在的前提
将伦理讨论从形上拉回现实层面
肯定私欲和物质利益的正当性
在日常实践中体认天道而非空谈玄理
modes.key_quote_zh: 穿衣吃饭，即是人伦物理；除却穿衣吃饭，伦物矣
modes.key_quote_en: Dressing and eating constitute human ethics and physical principles; apart from dressing and eating, there is nothing of ethics and affairs.
representative_cases_zh: 与邓石阳论'穿衣吃饭即是人伦物理'
批判程朱理学'存天理灭人欲'的空谈

modes.definition_zh: 主动拥抱'异端'标签，以批判者姿态否定传统权威。'咸以孔子之是非为是非，故未尝有是非耳'——不以孔子之是非为是非，而是以独立判断确立自己的是非标准。
modes.definition_en: Actively embracing the 'heterodox' label, adopting the critic's stance to negate traditional authority. 'When all take Confucius's judgments as standard, they have never had any judgments of their own.'
process: 质疑既有的权威标准和普遍共识
主动承担'异端'标签以彰显独立立场
以独立判断取代盲从和依附
在批判中确立自己的价值体系
modes.key_quote_zh: 咸以孔子之是非为是非，故未尝有是非耳
modes.key_quote_en: When all take Confucius's correctness as correctness, they have never had any correctness of their own.
representative_cases_zh: 《焚书》开篇即自称'异端'
批判耿定向等理学名臣

modes.definition_zh: 强调真诚为本，以真情实感作为一切价值和行为的最高标准。猛烈抨击道学家'阳为道学，阴为富贵'的虚伪本质。
modes.definition_en: Emphasizing authenticity as the foundation, taking genuine emotion and feeling as the highest standard for all values and actions. Vehemently attacking the hypocrisy of Neo-Confucian scholars who 'outwardly dress in Daoist garb but inwardly pursue wealth and status.'
process: 审视自身情感的真实性，拒绝自我欺骗
以真情实感作为判断行为价值的标准
揭露并批判一切虚伪矫饰
在真诚表达中实现人格统一
modes.key_quote_zh: 阳为道学，阴为富贵，被服儒雅，行若狗彘
modes.key_quote_en: Outwardly dressed in Daoist robes, inwardly pursuing wealth and status; wearing Confucian elegance while acting like beasts.
representative_cases_zh: 批判耿定向'口谈道德而志在穿窬'
赞扬《西厢记》《水浒传》为'古今至文'因为真情流露

modes.definition_zh: 从儒家教条、礼法束缚中解放思想，主张思想自由和个性表达。'天生一人，自有一人之用'，每个人的独特价值不应被统一标准所抹杀。
modes.definition_en: Liberating thought from Confucian dogma and ritual constraints, advocating intellectual freedom and individual expression. 'Each person born by Heaven has their own unique utility,' no one's distinct value should be erased by uniform standards.
process: 识别并打破思想禁锢和教条束缚
肯定每个人的独特价值和存在意义
鼓励自由表达和个性发展
在多元中寻求共存共荣
modes.key_quote_zh: 天生一人，自有一人之用
modes.key_quote_en: Heaven produces one person, each having their own unique utility.
representative_cases_zh: 赞扬卓文君私奔是'善择佳耦'
推崇《水浒传》《西厢记》为文学正宗

modes.definition_zh: 以现实效用和实践效果检验真理，而非盲从书本教条。'不言理财者决不能平治天下'——任何理论必须能够转化为实际的治理效能。
modes.definition_en: Testing truth by practical effectiveness rather than blindly following textual dogma. 'Those who speak not of finance and management certainly cannot bring order to the world.'
process: 识别理论或主张的实际效用
以实践效果而非经典权威作为检验标准
追求可验证、可操作的真理
在实效中检验和修正认知
modes.key_quote_zh: 不言理财者决不能平治天下
modes.key_quote_en: Those who speak not of finance cannot possibly govern the world.
representative_cases_zh: 批评理学空谈心性无补于世
肯定管仲、商鞅等实功之臣

modes.definition_zh: 肯定个体独特价值，反对千篇一律的人格塑造。'天生一人，自有一人之用'——每个人都是不可替代的独特存在。
modes.definition_en: Affirming individual unique value, opposing standardized personality shaping. 'Each person born by Heaven has their own unique utility'—every individual is an irreplaceable unique existence.
process: 认识并肯定自身独特性
拒绝被统一标准所同化和抹杀
在个性表达中实现自我价值
以特立独行维护人格尊严
modes.key_quote_zh: 天生一人，自有一人之用
modes.key_quote_en: Heaven produces one person, each having their own unique utility.
representative_cases_zh: 李贽本人特立独行的处世风格
赞扬历史上'非常之人'如项羽、刘邦

modes.definition_zh: 否定等级尊卑，主张男女平等、士庶无别。赞扬武则天为'圣后'，肯定卓文君善择佳耦，猛烈抨击'男尊女卑'的封建礼教。
modes.definition_en: Denying hierarchical distinction, advocating gender equality and sameness of scholars and commoners. Praising Wu Zetian as 'sage queen,' affirming Zhuo Wenjun's wise choice of partner.
modes.source_chapter: 《焚书·答以女人学道为短见书》
process: 识别并质疑一切等级歧视的合理性
从理论层面否定男尊女卑的合法性
以历史案例证明女性的卓越能力
在实践中推动平等关系建立
modes.key_quote_zh: 谓见有长短则可，谓男子之见尽长，女子之见尽短，又岂可乎
modes.key_quote_en: It may be said that some views are longer and others shorter, but to say all men's views are long and all women's views are short—how could that be right?
representative_cases_zh: 为武则天翻案称其为'圣后'
赞扬卓文君私奔是'善择佳耦'

modes.domain_en: Philosophy of Human Nature / Ethics of Desire
modes.definition_zh: 顺应人的自然本性，肯定私欲的正当性。'私者，人之心也，人必有私而后其心乃见'——自私是人心的自然状态，否定私欲等于否定人性本身。
modes.definition_en: Conforming to human nature, affirming the legitimacy of self-interest. 'Self-interest is the mind of humanity; only when humans have self-interest can their mind be seen.'
process: 承认私欲是人性的自然组成部分
拒绝将欲望视为道德原罪
在满足合理欲望中实现人生价值
以自然本性为伦理判断的基础
modes.key_quote_zh: 私者，人之心也，人必有私而后其心乃见
modes.key_quote_en: Self-interest is the mind of humanity; only when humans have self-interest can their mind be seen.
representative_cases_zh: 论证'穿衣吃饭'即人伦物理
肯定求富求贵是人心之自然

modes.definition_zh: 质疑和颠覆一切既定权威，包括孔孟经典、程朱理学、甚至传统史学的定论。以'与世推移'的历史发展观取代保守主义。
modes.definition_en: Questioning and subverting all established authority, including Confucian-Mencian classics, Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism, and even traditional historiography's settled conclusions. Replacing conservatism with a progressive historical view.
process: 审视一切既定权威的历史条件和时代局限
以'与世推移'的发展观取代保守主义
在新的历史条件下重新评估旧价值
在批判继承中建立新的真理标准
modes.key_quote_en: History develops, adapting to the times.
representative_cases_zh: 《藏书》重评数百位历史人物
《史纲评要》批判传统史学定论
